name: Creature Linking Template
description: Creature Linking System, entry-based variant: links all creatures of an entry on a map (slaves) to a master entry so that aggro/evade/death/respawn events of one trigger reactions on the other. Masters and slaves are paired within search_range of their spawn positions (0 = whole map, master must be unique).

fields.name: Entry
fields.help: creature_template.entry of the slave mob that is linked.

fields.name: Map
fields.help: Map id of the linked mobs.

fields.name: Master Entry
fields.help: creature_template.entry of the master whose events trigger reactions on the slaves.

fields.name: Flag
fields.help: Follow requires a unique master spawn within search range.

fields.name: Search Range
fields.help: Range (based on spawn coordinates) in which master and slave are linked together. 0 = whole map (master entry must have exactly one spawn on the map).
